sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer. We propose to keep today's price of EUR 48.60 per piece for 24 months at 30 days payment.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract, as long-term stability is highly valued by our family-run foundry. Our region and our traditional craft depend on such lasting bonds. However, maintaining the current price is not possible due to the sustained increases in our wage costs. In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to offer €51.40 per unit for the extended 24-month term starting January 1, 2027.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €51.40 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and is valid from 1 January 2027. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation for many years to come.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
